summary.intent: Continue identifying, verifying and addressing the recurring defect patterns found in earlier code and slop reviews of the monokl repo, via a broad read-only sweep followed by fixes.
summary.outcome: Stack-overflow fix landed as PR #43 (wave 1 now #41-#43). A 51-agent sweep produced 191 raw findings (177 deduped, 40 verified: 23 confirmed, 17 not confirmed). Findings were ranked and mapped to mechanical guards. Trail 200 ('Every fact has one owner') was created and a worktree agent started on copy-drift fixes.

repo: OXC 0.152 has no recursion depth limit; the 256-deep bracket scan was not a real bound (regex quotes, arrows, conditionals, generics and JSX recurse without brackets). PR #43 parses each file on its own thread with 8 MiB + 4 KiB stack per source byte, and degrades files over ~254 KiB (release) or ~85 KiB (unoptimized).
Design rationale for the parse stack-overflow fix is recorded as section 22 of docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md.

Copy drift is widespread: the Callisto pin appears in 11 places, default caps in 6, the coverage threshold in 4, and MSRV in both .clippy.toml and Cargo.toml. core-types.md says '4 variants' where there are 13.
Shape-only tests are a large share of the suite: tests_types.rs is 2,948 lines of mostly serde/derive shape, plus ~300 lexer lines using include_str!, and query/mod.rs reads its own source.

Known defects include diagnostics never being rendered and .d.mts files leaking through. The verifier wrongly marked these 'not confirmed' because it judged the category didn't fit, not because the defects were absent.
Several error-recovery and hint strings reference things that don't exist: an `extract` command and a `maxTerms` param for TooManyTerms.
AGENTS.md forbids wildcard arms on MonoklError, but agent.rs:707 has one.

code.finding: A failed stdout write is discarded and the process still exits SUCCESS. The stderr write at line 91 has the same problem. Fix: return ExitCode::FAILURE, optionally treating BrokenPipe as success.
Operator-only queries (`regex:`, `+`, `-`) return an empty result with no diagnostic.
Wildcard arm on MonoklError violates the AGENTS.md rule.
catch_unwind turns parser panics into Extraction::degraded(). It still needs checking that had_parse_errors is set so a diagnostic exists, though diagnostics are never rendered.

workflow: Workflow orchestration (51 agents, ~3M tokens, ~7.4 min) works well for broad read-only sweeps, but the result is too large to read inline. Parse the output file and journal.jsonl instead.
LLM verifier agents can reject real findings by judging category fit. Read the 'not confirmed' list manually before discarding it.
Coverage agents reported unread areas, which makes it possible to state what was not audited rather than implying full coverage.
Pair each recurring defect pattern with a mechanical guard (CI grep, drift-check test, clippy lint, contract test) instead of one-off fixes.
Use one PR per pattern with its own trail item, run sequentially so PRs don't conflict.

friction: The 36-task eval directories under /tmp/claude-501/eval-* no longer exist, so class 11 could not audit the eval and the '6.4x tokens, 34/36 vs 20/36' numbers can't be re-verified.
The verification filter mislabelled real, known defects as not confirmed (15 of 17 rejections were category-fit judgments).
Only 40 of 177 findings were verified, leaving 137 unverified.

The assistant's own stress script reports a cumulative-maximum RSS, so many per-run memory numbers are invalid. The 20k-file timing used unrealistic identical files, and mutation runs covered only 13 of 33 files with timeouts counted as caught.
Spec files 02-08, some proptests and dependabot.yml were only grepped or unread by some agents.
CI for #43 was still pending on macOS and Entire Gates when reported.
open_items: Review and merge PRs #41 (Callisto 0.17), #42 (pinning tests) and #43 (stack-overflow fix).
User decision needed: remove or implement the bogus hints and recovery text (the `extract` command and the `maxTerms` param).
Phase 7 PRs still to do, sequentially: copy drift (trail 200, in progress), silent-output contract tests, shape-test cleanup, dead-API trim.
Trail 184 remaining work: per-file size cap on the walk, regex limits, memory.
Files over 254 KiB are now silently skipped (0.56% of TS/JS files, mostly bundler output) until diagnostics rendering lands.
Per-byte stack constants were calibrated only on aarch64 macOS, with a 2.4x margin. Edge cases remain: release builds at opt-level=0 without debug assertions, and strict overcommit.

Verify the 137 unverified findings, starting with the high-confidence ones: coverage_boost always 1.0, --language identical for JS and TS, --max-tokens doc mismatch, and a file as search root reported as external_failure instead of invalid_input.
A regex-only query gives every row finalScore 1 yet still shows it as a rank.
Rebuild the eval harness from scratch and save it into the repo.
Settings still open: Entire Gates for Dependabot PRs and branch protection requiring code-owner review.
Numbers in the assistant's own summaries still need a second-agent recheck per the sweep rules.
